ElectHQ is a data driven campaign management platform built specifically for local and state-level candidates. It's an all-in-one digital command center that brings together data management, canvassing, voter outreach, volunteer mobilization, and donors in a single, intelligent platform. Our mission is to democratize political technology to make it accessible, affordable, and empowering for every community leader who dreams of making a difference. VICTORY WAVES Home How it works Pricing FAQ Contact Toggle Sidebar VICTORY WAVES About Victory Waves Victory Waves builds modern, data-driven tools that help campaigns and civic organizations connect with voters, run smarter field programs, and scale impact. We believe healthy democracies are competitive, accessible, and people-powered. Our Mission Our mission is to lower the barrier to entry for effective campaigning. More than 70% of elected offices go uncontested every cycle. By giving candidates and civic organizations access to high-quality voter data, intuitive workflows, and AI-assisted insights, we aim to make running—and winning—more attainable for people committed to public service. Who We Serve We partner with registered political candidates, 501(c)(3) organizations, and PACs aligned with progressive and/or democratic values. Whether you're launching your first run for office, organizing a community petition, or scaling a statewide program, our platform adapts to your needs.
